description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Attach Fire with Stacking], [Awoken High Summoner], and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user, grants [High Summoner's Locus Mode]/[High Summoner's Coterie Mode] to the user if 0/1+ of Auron or Jecht are alive

description.name: Awoken High Summoner
description.text: Fire abilities don't consume uses, cast speed x2.00/2.25/2.50/2.75/3.00 for Fire abilities at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, casts Flamebeast Flex after using Fire abilities

description.name: Flamebeast Flex
description.text: Six single attacks (2.44 each), grants [Buff Fire 10% (15s)] to the user every second cast

description.name: Buff Fire 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Fire damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: High Summoner's Locus Mode
description.text: Fire abilities deal 10/20/30% more damage after using 0/1/2+ Fire abilities

description.name: High Summoner's Coterie Mode
description.text: Fire abilities deal 10/30/50% more damage after using 0/1/2+ Fire abilities
